messages.1000002:
Hi, I'm Lytle and I'm in charge around here now.
Nice to meet you.
messages.1000003:
It seems we've finally received the elves' understanding
and permission.  Please resume the investigation
of the Mining Tunnel of Yugunos for our operations.
messages.1000004:
To reach the Mining Tunnel of Yugunos, go southwest of Butterfly Hill
and climb a mountain road called Dragon Road.
messages.1000006:
Please avoid the Seal Facilities as much as possible
to keep the trust of the elves...
messages.1000007:
Well, as I thought, the Seal Facilities are damaged,
so the path to the end of the mining tunnel is blocked.
It's only a matter of time before the dragons wake up.
messages.1000008:
In order to increase the sealing power against the dragons,
Kirarru has asked us to recapture the Power Supply Facility
that the Demons took.  The facility is beyond Mouve's Labyrinth,
far south of the Village of Elves.
messages.1000009: Please head for the facility at once.
messages.1000010:
The Power Supply is far south of this town.
Good luck!
messages.1000011:
Good job.  This is a reward for your efforts.
Thank you.
messages.1000012:
You might have already heard from Kirarru,
but you are about to be given a very difficult mission.
messages.1000014:
As Kirarru suggested, you should weaken the dragons
temporarily by increasing the sealing power first.
After that, you'll have a chance fighting against them.
messages.1000015:
If you hesitate, understand that the seal of the dragons
will break eventually.
It's a terrible choice to have to make.
messages.1000016:
...No one will blame you if you leave.
The decision is yours to make.
messages.1000018:
You're a hero and will be well remembered.
Thank you very much for your efforts!
messages.1000019:
Although this time
the reward is not very big,
you've gained our highestest esteem.
messages.1000020:
Why don't you head for the central front now.
You'll be treated very well due to what you've
accomplished.
messages.1000021:
Of course, I will let them know you have my
strongest recommendation.
messages.1000022:
No one fights against the dragons for honor nowadays.
Everyone is too afraid.
messages.1000023:
I don't know who you are or what you're thinking,
but I certainly think you have the ability to change the world.
messages.1000024: You're exactly what this world needs.
messages.1000025:
Anyhow, thank you for your work.
Please get some rest.
messages.1000026:
Battles that may change the world are being fought at the central
front everyday. You may be the person who holds
the key to winning it all.  You seem to have a unique destiny.
messages.1000027:
If you continue on with your journey,
it would be great if you could pass through there...
messages.1000028:
According to the latest report, our surprise attack
succeeded.  However, the resistance was very strong
and your help is needed to replace our exhausted soldiers.
messages.1000029:
Anyhow, please head for the Yugunos Camp.
You can get there quickly
using the Warp Gate.
messages.1000031:
Welcome.
I'm Orbella, the elder of this forest.
messages.1000032:
I heard about everything from Kirushutat.
I'll cooperate with the army operation as much as possible.
messages.1000033:
As for the seal of the Dragons,
please deal with it very carefully.
A fate is looming which we cannot avoid...
messages.1000036:
I still cannot believe it.
Did you really destroy the Dragons?
messages.1000037:
Oh.  We assumed we would spend the rest of our lives
cowering in the shadow of those beasts,
but you rid us of those anxieties.
messages.1000038:
I can't find any words to thank you.
All I can say is thank you! Thank you so much!
We'll gladly cooperate with the army again.
messages.1000039:
A new hero has been added to our history.
And we've found a great friend.
messages.1000040: May the grace of God be with you!
messages.1000041:
The gem of the Holy Spirit King, Oberon?
You've heard of it?
messages.1000042:
Well...
There's been trouble since someone stole
the gem of King Oberon.
messages.1000043: Why don't we get it back?
messages.1000044:
Yes, you'd definitely earn a reward
if you could return it to its rightful
owner.
messages.1000046:
Dark Elves had it?
...some of us suspected them.
messages.1000047:
I didn't think you would really get it back...
As a reward, I will allow you to use the Big Warehouse V.
messages.1000048:
Hi, my name is Kirarru.
I'm partially in charge of the Seal Facilities for the Dragons.
messages.1000049:
The facilities are in danger
because a group of thieves attacked them.
The emergency protection device has already been partly activated.
messages.1000051: If you find anything, please let me know.
messages.1000052: Did you find a blocked area in the Mining Tunnel of Yugunos B2F?
messages.1000053:
Well, the auto emergency protection device might be active.
To clear it, we have to cancel the operation
by entering the control room from an underground passage,
which is to the south of the Mining Tunnel of Yugunos.
messages.1000054:
Unfortunately, we cannot approach the control room
because monsters have occupied the underground passage.
messages.1000055:
Would you somehow rid us of the monsters
so we can get to the control room?
messages.1000056:
Looks like you've recaptured the Control Room.
I'll start the cancel operation for the emergency device.
messages.1000057: It'll be clear until you reach the emergency device.
messages.1000058:
I see.
The Seal Facilities have been severely damaged.  To our regret,
it seems we cannot avoid the revival of the Dragons anymore.
messages.1000059:
Some of the protective walls have allegedly been destroyed
by the Dark Elves, so the power of the seal has
undoubtedly decreased.
messages.1000060:
The Dragons will break the seal
by themselves and escape...
messages.1000062:
If that happens, this area will be burned to the ground
like Kirushutat's country..
messages.1000063:
No!
We have to stop them!
messages.1000064: I've heard about your skills. May I ask a favor of you?
messages.1000065: Would you please battle the Dragons?
messages.1000066:
I know this is a reckless plan,
but there is still hope.
If we move all of the energy to the seal,
the Dragons cannot use their full power...
messages.1000067: And with your great skills, you may actually defeat the dragons.
messages.1000068:
This is our only chance.
Please help us!
Discuss it with your commander if you like.
messages.1000069:
I understand that fighting against the dragons
is out of the question,
but we have no alternatives...
messages.1000070:
Now, we're going to increase the power of the seal
using all the energy we have.
messages.1000071:
What I can do is increase the power of the seal
and weaken the power of the Dragons...
messages.1000073:
It's hard to believe that a person capable of defeating the dragons
really exists... I apologize for having asked so much of you.
Oh, thank you so much!
messages.1000074:
Oh, what a stupid thing
I've done...
messages.1000075:
I neglected my daughter and now she's
run off!
messages.1000076:
I've inherited the honorable name of my family, Gal Ton,
yet I've failed to make my only daughter happy!
messages.1000077:
I ignored her feelings to protect
the traditions of this house.
messages.1000078:
Limina! Limina... Is she all right?
I'm worried. I'm so worried...
messages.1000079:
Oh, it's you guys.  You startled me...
Can I ask you to do me a favor?
messages.1000081:
She must be hiding at Dr. Rordon's laboratory to the east.
She's probably against the arranged marriage
I've set up with Devalio.
messages.1000082:
Please tell her that if she comes back,
she can do as she pleases.
messages.1000083:
And please say thank you to Dr. Rordon.
We caused him a lot of trouble.
messages.1000084:
Please.
I'll be counting on you.
messages.1000086:
Thank you for your effort.
I'm glad to hear that Limina is fine.
messages.1000087:
But, why did she say that she needs more time?
What is she planning?
messages.1000089:
I have an idea!  I've heard all about you.  I know you're busy, but
considering your great skills, I'd like to ask of you another favor...
messages.1000090:
Could you help Limina with
whatever she's planning?
messages.1000091: Here's your reward in advance.  Please take it.
messages.1000093:
I see.  My son fell into the trap as I thought he would.
It was inevitable that this would happen.
messages.1000094:
We may have shown disrespect for the dignity of the elves.
We shouldn't have allowed him to deal with the Dark Elves.
messages.1000095: Devalio's involvement has lead to our ruin...
messages.1000096:
Please help us.
Please stop Devalio's evil doings!
messages.1000097:
As an elf, I feel obligated to make up for Devalio's mistakes.
Please!
messages.1000098:
I don't know how to thank you enough...
So many elves were involved in this confusion,
but you came through for us.
messages.1000099: This is a small present for you.  Please take it.
messages.1000100:
Oh, thank you very much for your help!
My son and daughter seem to have matured
as a result of this experience.
messages.1000101:
Although we've lost a lot,
we've gained something greater.
messages.1000103:
I hope you have a safe trip.
Thank you again.
messages.1000104:
Don't talk such nonsense!  Why would my dad ask you for your help?
You're one of the reasons why everyone looks down on me!
He has tarnished the reputation of the Gal Ton!
messages.1000105:
What are you?  A warrior?  You must be joking!
Are you laughing at me!?
messages.1000106:
You rat, go away!
I'll kill you if you ever look down
on me again!
messages.1000107: You fool!  I am... I am!
messages.1000108: Damn it.  Why can't I rise above my father...
messages.1000109:
There is nothing that bothers me more than the differences
between my father and I.
messages.1000111:
...Ah, I'm sorry
for being so rude.
......
messages.1000112:
The lessons of the Holy Spirits will be destroyed because of me.
Damn it!
messages.1000113:
...I see.  If Dr.Rordon said so, I will follow his advice.
I'm just a pawn in this game.
messages.1000114:
Thank you for everything.
I may eventually regain my bearings thanks to you.
Your eyes are filled with so much confidence...
I was once an Elf Ranger, and I respect the strength
I see in you.
messages.1000116:
Anyway, I'll see what I can do for you
by talking to my Elf Ranger friends.
messages.1000117:
And please tell Limina not to work too hard
if that is possible!
messages.1000118:
My dad and Limina are
worried about me...
They think I'm still so immature.
messages.1000119:
....
Limina seems to be working
really hard...(sigh)
messages.1000120:
By the way, the Elf Rangers told me
they found some interesting information.
I already sent the information to Dr. Rordon.
messages.1000121:
Since I'm busy right now,
I've asked Dr. Rordon
to file a report about it.
messages.1000122:
I heard that Devalio has committed an injustice...
Can I ask a favor of you?  Would you help me reveal his wrongdoings?
Please go see Dr. Rordon and discuss it with him.
messages.1000123:
Now that I've met you,
I feel like I want to pick up a sword and a bow again...
messages.1000124: But I have other things to do.
messages.1000125:
To tell you the truth, I hate Devalio, but he's an elf just like me.
I don't want him to get into any trouble.
Please help us.
messages.1000126:
I wish we knew about
Devalio's wrongdoings earlier.
messages.1000127:
You did a great job!
Devalio is now back with the elves.
Don't worry,  we'll take care of Devalio from now on
because we are also responsible for this matter...
messages.1000128:
The road that lies ahead may be steep for you,
but it's much easier compared to the path of your enemies.
messages.1000129:
You've taught me a lot.  Thank you very much.
This is for you.  Unfortunately, I'm not doing so well,
so this is all I can give you.
messages.1000130:
Maybe I should study harder.  It is impossible to exceed
my father's accomplishments with my present abilities.
messages.1000132:
Dr. Rordon!
How many times have I told you
I don't like being called that?!
messages.1000133:
Dr. Rordon!
Stop calling me a little girl!
(upset)
messages.1000134:
Oh, I'm sorry.  I didn't see you...
You're...
You must be the warrior that destroyed the Gargoyles!
I heard that the Wizard Kirushutat asked you to come here.
messages.1000136:
Oh, I forgot to introduce myself.
I'm Limina.  Nice to meet you.
messages.1000137:
I'm a daughter of the Gal Ton.  I've been hiding here.
Please don't give away my secret.
messages.1000138:
My father asked you to find me?
Was he worried?  I'm sorry.
I didn't want to cause so much trouble...
messages.1000139:
Please tell my dad
that I need to stay here awhile longer.
I don't intend to return yet.
messages.1000140: Please make sure he gets that message.
messages.1000141:
I'm glad you came back.  Did my father say anything?
How did he react?
I'm such a troublemaker...
messages.1000142: Can I ask you a favor?
messages.1000143:
Well, I have a story to tell you about my father, the Gal Ton,
who planned to borrow a lot of money from Devalio
because we were facing financial difficulties.
messages.1000144:
The cause of the financial problems was the failure of a company
run by my brother Bolzo.  However, it turns out
that Devalio may have tricked him.
messages.1000145:
My brother is consumed with the idea of exceeding
our father's expectations.
messages.1000147:
There weren't any problems while my brother was in control of
the company, but one time, he let our father's old relatives
fill in for him because he trusted them.
messages.1000148:
Then large debts began to pile up. It seemed someone was using
the company's credit.  The person who was in charge of the company
at that time has disappeared along with the company's money.
messages.1000149:
That person also purchased other companies with the money
for extremely high prices.  It turned out that those companies
had a lot of debt too...
messages.1000150:
Although my father tried to pay off the debt,
he couldn't cover it all.  Finally, he decided
to borrow money from Devalio, my father's rival.
messages.1000151:
However, he gave us strict conditions.
He wanted control of this coal mine.
messages.1000152:
Under his control, the lessons of the legendary Holy Spirits are
disappearing. These lessons have been sacred to us for a long time,
and we're trying to keep them from being completely lost.
messages.1000153:
Devalio told me he wouldn't destroy
the lessons of the Holy Spirits if I married his son.
My father agreed and accepted the offer.
I can't believe he did that.
messages.1000154:
Well, of course I don't want to get married
to Devalio's son.
messages.1000155:
And I hardly know anything about him. I also want to investigate
this loan issue with Devalio a little more.
messages.1000156:
Dr. Rordon is also working with me,
so I need a little more time out here.
messages.1000157:
If you could help us with this situation,
I'd be very appreciative.
messages.1000160:
What? My brother says, "Don't work too hard?"
Give him the same message.
messages.1000161:
Thank you for delivering these messages for me.
My brother must think of you as our carrier pigeon.
messages.1000162:
Please don't be upset by my words.  Well...
Oh, yes!  I should think my brother would have gathered
information from the Elf Rangers by now!
messages.1000163:
Thank you very much.  My brother was depressed,
but he seems to be recovering because of you.
messages.1000164:
You're more than I expected... When I first saw you,
I thought you could be counted on to some point.
But now, I've learned that I can rely on you completely.
messages.1000165:
Wow!
How on earth could one do such a thing?
I could never do what you do!
messages.1000166:
Thank you for your help.
You're a very courageous person.
messages.1000167:
I also feel that I should work much harder.
I have to tell Dr. Rordon... Oh, never mind!
messages.1000169:
Please make a habit of helping those in
need.  I'll try to do the same!
messages.1000170:
Muah ha ha... I've been waiting for this moment.
The final moments of Gal Ton.
messages.1000171: They're just about to fall into the hands of the Devalio family.
messages.1000172:
My long days of suffering will finally end.
Gal Ton will be under Devalio command!
messages.1000173:
The lessons of the Holy Spirits? They're just an
excuse to make money.
messages.1000174:
I, Barrio Devalio, will show that coward Gal Ton
how it's really done!
messages.1000175:
The Lessons of the Holy Spirits make me sick!
To make money, maybe we should offer the precious mineral
resources of this town at bargain prices.
This'll appease our traditional buyers...
messages.1000176:
This is no joke!
Peace is had only
when the strong firmly control the weak!
messages.1000177:
Gal Ton's lenient ways cause
nothing but disputes!
messages.1000178:
After I make this mine powerful,
I will prove my abilities.
messages.1000179:
...(malicious laugh)  I feel like scaring the hell
out of the country people who tried to get rid of us...
messages.1000180:
They are in our hands now.
Watch. We will deliver the fatal blow soon!
messages.1000181:
No!!! My plans!
You bastard, Gal Ton!
messages.1000182:
This is not the end of me...
I will avenge myself some day!
messages.1000183: Who?  You're a human, aren't you?
messages.1000184:
I find it interesting that
lower animals like you have brains.
messages.1000185:
I'm Denin Devalio, the future ruler
of this area!
messages.1000186:
Bow to me now!
No?
You animals just don't understand.
messages.1000187:
You are no good at anything.  It may be best
to just destroy your useless species entirely, no?
messages.1000188:
Especially you.
I don't like your eyes.
messages.1000189:
After this incident is over, you'll be
the first I ask my dad to kill.
messages.1000190:
I'll tell you something.
There is a God at the top of this world,
and we, the elves of the Devalio clan, are one small step below.
messages.1000191:
The slave elves like the Gal Ton are
far below us.
messages.1000192: And then there are humans much further below.
messages.1000193:
Do you understand?  That is the social system of this world.
You're a follower.
He he he (laughs proudly)
messages.1000194:
I should watch what I say in front humans,
regardless of their stupidity.
(smirk)
messages.1000195:
Dad, you should destroy Gal Ton immediately.
I cannot wait any longer!
messages.1000196:
Limina will be my wife soon.
Ha ha ha!
messages.1000197:
Did Limina run away from home!?
What a pretty one she is.
messages.1000198:
(malicious laugh)  I can't wait to give her
something to cry about after we're married.
Dad, I can wait no longer!
messages.1000199:
Dad, I'm growing impatient!
Please get Limina back right now!
And I expect my birthday gift to be
twice the amount of last year's!
messages.1000200:
What?  What's going on!?
What are my followers doing!
messages.1000201: Those who would not dare to look me in the eyes!
messages.1000202:
Where have they found the courage to throw stones at me!  Ouch!
I'm bleeding! Damn it!  I should have hung more of them from the
trees when I had a chance! They would have learned their lesson!
messages.1000206:
What is wrong with everyone?
Don't look at me like that!
What's the big deal with being a Dark Elf?
Is it such a bad thing?
messages.1000207:
My dad is different from you.  He is great!
He can do whatever he likes since he is an admirable elf!
You just envy him because you are poor! Isn't that right?
Admit it!
messages.1000208:
Why?
Why do they ignore my words?
This is crazy...
messages.1000209:
Dad... You must...
Help me...
Dad!
messages.1000210:
Did you hear the news?  The prominent elf families
in this forest are fighting with each other.
messages.1000211:
The struggle between the Gal Tons and the Devalios.
It's exciting to imagine the outcome!
messages.1000212:
The Gal Tons have always won in the past.
The Devalios seem mean and don't impress
anyone.
messages.1000213:
Gal Ton has many supporters because he is the guardian
of the lessons of the Holy Spirits.
messages.1000214:
They say that an ancestor of Gal Ton found this mine
under the guidance of the Holy Spirits.  It is true that
many rare minerals are found in this mine?
messages.1000215: Because of their fame, the family stays hidden and is very mysterious.
messages.1000216:
There is a big difference between the Gal Tons' image
and the Devalios'.
messages.1000217:
Gal Ton has maintained the family name for a long time.
But Bolzo, his heir, seems to make big mistakes.
He's been in a real pinch lately.
messages.1000218: I'd hate to see Gal Ton defeated by Devalio.
messages.1000219:
By the way, there is a rumor
that his daughter, Limina, has disappeared.
messages.1000220:
Everyone suspects she has hidden in
Dr. Rordon's laboratory. I heard that
the two of them are close.
messages.1000221:
Dr. Rordon is the best of engineers.
He can refine magic crystals.
messages.1000222:
He is a human being, but Limina doesn't care and
admires him.  They may be together in the future...
(smiles meaningfully)
messages.1000223: I wish I had a nice boyfriend.
messages.1000224:
I heard that Devalio's illegal dealings with the Dark Elves
has been revealed!  The fraud he perpetuated at Gal Ton's expense
was also exposed. He cannot avoid punishment now.
messages.1000225:
The executive elf that ruined Bolzo's company
was also arrested.  Gal Ton's luck has changed.
messages.1000226:
It's going to be a little boring now that Devalio
can no longer compete as a rival.
messages.1000227:
Well, the situation will change soon.  Since Gal Ton isn't
monopolizing the mine, other people may make good use
of this chance.
messages.1000228: What'll happen next? I can't wait to find out!
messages.1000230:
Limina.
I'm worried about you.
Mr. Gal Ton must be losing his mind
since you ran away from home.
messages.1000231:
Let me introduce myself.
I'm Dr. Rordon, and we study refining techniques
for the minerals that we find in this mine.
messages.1000232:
Precious minerals can be found in Gal Ton's mountains
around here; however, people are constantly
fighting over the minerals...
messages.1000233:
This time Devalio had an advantage over Gal Ton.
Since the Gal Tons want to maintain management
of the mountains, Limina has been offered
to a Devalio.
messages.1000234:
I understand how she feels.  It's not like I wanted
to marry her anyway...
messages.1000235:
Anyway, your family must be worried
about you Limina!
messages.1000236:
I didn't know Limina was so reflective...
She's matured into a woman so quickly.
messages.1000237:
Don't stare at me Limina.
You're not a little girl anymore.
messages.1000239:
Anyhow, I also investigated Devalio's activities.
I talked to the laboratory workers and customers
who purchase crystals.
messages.1000240:
There have been bad rumors about Devalio
for some time now.
messages.1000241:
In the eyes of elves, illegal dealings with Dark Elves
is as bad as selling your soul to the Devil.
messages.1000242:
It's likely that Devalio started the illegal deals
because he didn't want to miss a big chance
to make money off of this war.  He also wanted some
funds to fight against Gal Ton.
messages.1000243:
A war against Gal Ton
would've cost a lot of money.
messages.1000245:
Yes!  I heard that Limina's brother
used to belong to the Elf Rangers,
and he fought the Dark Elves several times.
messages.1000246:
He could probably get some information about the Dark Elves
by asking his Elf Ranger friends.
messages.1000247:
Please.
Would you please see him and tell him about our conversation?
messages.1000248:
Sorry for causing you so much trouble.
I'll also try to do some investigating.
messages.1000249:
Thank you for your help.  Based on the information you've gathered,
it's clear Devalio is having illegal dealings
with the Dark Elves.
messages.1000250:
Every time someone suspected something scandalous,
he covered it up...
messages.1000251:
It seems we've finally found some conclusive evidence.
In a small shrine to the west, illegal items from a deal
with the Dark Elves have been stockpiled.
These items may be camouflaged as normal items there.
messages.1000252:
Illegal medicines, prohibited arms,
magic equipment, and so on.
messages.1000253:
If we could get our hands on these items,
we could prove Devalio's malicious conduct.
messages.1000254:
If the relationships between influential elves and Dark Elves
grows stronger, this area will be consumed by violence
and drug dependence.
messages.1000255:
We have to stop them, but our army and
Elf Rangers are already busy at a war.  They don't have
any time to deal with thieves like these.
messages.1000256:
Besides, if we meddle in their dealings,
our investigation will be hampered
by Devalio's supporters.
messages.1000257:
That's why I've decided to ask you for help.
Although you're not familiar to anyone here, your skills and character
have been confirmed by the Allied Forces and the Wizard Kirushutat.
messages.1000258:
You're the only one who can avoid Devalio's influences
and act in this situation.
messages.1000259:
No one but you can reveal
Devalio's evil conduct.
messages.1000260:
So I have a favor to ask of you.  Devalio's Hidden Warehouse is
at the far end of the Forest of Wesley once you've passed through to
the northwest of Butterfly Hill.
Please go there and expose his illegal dealings.
messages.1000261: This is a difficult task, but we really need your help.
messages.1000262:
You made it!  With this evidence, we finally have
enough to accuse him.  Devalio cannot escape anymore!
messages.1000263:
You really are as great as they say!
You've beaten the Dark Elves garrison!
Thank you very much.  My laboratory will also be safe
thanks to you.
messages.1000264:
Your abilities are as great as they've been
saying.
messages.1000265:
Hello.
We refine minerals and study them here.
messages.1000266:
Dr. Rordon's refining techniques are great.
We use them on the tools that Kirushutat
and other wizards use.
messages.1000267:
Gal Ton is a good person.
He hires employees regardless of
whether they are human beings or elves.
messages.1000268:
It's probably because
he trusts Dr. Rordon.
messages.1000269:
If this place were to come under the control of Devalio...
(shudder)
I don't want to think about it.
messages.1000270:
Devalio is greedy.  He works his
employees too hard.
messages.1000271:
Those who have money are loved by God and the rest are slaves.
That's Devalio's rationalization.
messages.1000272: He punishes people who complain without mercy.
messages.1000273: From my point of view, it's a scary situation.
messages.1000274:
Hi, I've heard about you.
You revealed Devalio's illegal deal.
Good job!
messages.1000275:
But I still don't understand why Gal Ton
